claims: SpaceX successfully launched a Falcon 9 rocket from Space Launch Complex 4E (SLC-4E) at Vandenberg Space Force Base, California.
The Falcon 9 rocket carried 25 Starlink satellites for the Starlink 17-35 mission.
The launch occurred on Monday, April 6, 2026, at 7:49 p.m. PT (10:49 p.m. ET).
The mission took a southerly trajectory.
The launch was visible across Southern California.
The first-stage booster landed on the drone ship "Of Course I Still Love You" in the Pacific Ocean.
This was the 10th flight for the first-stage booster.
